title: The bird after the Fourth
logline: The seawall the week after the Fourth: spent tubes in the gutter, a dropped flag on a stick, and the bird on the wall among it, every color, cleaner than anything on the page.

panels.composition: The seawall in July morning light with spent firework tubes and a small paper flag on a stick in the gutter below it, the small rainbow bird on the wall above the litter.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in July morning light with spent firework tubes and a small paper flag on a stick in the gutter below, a small rainbow bird perched on the wall above the litter, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
